## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      9 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Sep 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Aaren Arnolds_, Sep 23, 2026, 2/5: "The idea behind the app is excellent, but the app itself is not worth it. Typing is constantly laggy, and the documents often bug out and can't be edited unless you close then open them again. Text selecting tool is awful; it teleports from what you're trying to select onto text that needs to stay unselected. Buttons are desynced, I need to hit Bold in order to italicise, or Italics to underline. Formatting settings are kinda awkward and also laggy. Shame, considering it's the best option."
            2. _James Hellriegel Jr._, Sep 21, 2026, 2/5: "I want to love this app but it's buggy. In particular selecting cells (for eventually copy/paste) is a nightmare. Also when connected to Nextcloud it seems impossible to get rid of the dumb warnings that pop up every single time you open a document. Functionally otherwise it's okay but it really falls short of Excel."
            3. _Jim_, Jul 15, 2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
<!--/ir-theme-->
